name: Pennsylvania Vendor Intake Gate x402
description: Checks a prospective Pennsylvania vendor inside an agent workflow and returns proceed or human_review with auditable PA registry, Census address, OFAC candidate-screen, and RDAP evidence.

skills.name: Pennsylvania Vendor Intake Gate
skills.description: Given a prospective vendor name, U.S. address, and domain, run a bounded four-source intake check and return proceed or human_review with explicit evidence and review triggers.
examples: Check whether this Pennsylvania vendor can continue through automated intake.
Pause vendor onboarding for human review if registry identity, address consistency, OFAC candidate screening, or domain registration triggers review.

limitations: proceed is a workflow signal, not legal/compliance approval or sanctions clearance
OFAC evidence is candidate-name screening only and does not implement 50 Percent Rule ownership analysis
PA registry matching does not prove good standing or ownership
Census matching does not prove control of an address
RDAP registration does not prove domain ownership
